Integrate 35 open generative models
text-to-image · image editing · text-to-video
standardize code, prompts, and fixed inference settings

Build prompt and output pool
live user prompts + ImagenHub/VBench samples
precompute model outputs in GenAI-Museum

Run anonymous same-task battles
randomly choose two model outputs
present them side-by-side without identities

Collect four-way community votes
left better · right better
tie good · both bad

Audit human-vote quality
authors review 350 sampled votes; 303 valid
93.07% clearly or vaguely reasonable

Clean arena votes with Llama Guard
remove NSFW and technical failures
retain task, prompt, output pair, models, and vote

Release GenAI-Bench preference pairs
image generation 1,735 · editing 919
video generation 1,069 · total 3,723

Prompt an MLLM as the preference judge
provide prompt plus the two generated contents
require one of the same four exact labels

Exact-match MLLM vote to human vote
report accuracy for three tasks and average
random four-class baseline is about 25%
